meta.notes: A new picture at the asked size from one to nine reference pictures, the Qwen-Image-2.1 way: the text-to-image template (qwen-2.1/image) with the references on TextEncodeQwenImage21's images inputs and its vae, as the official edit template (image_qwen_image_2_1_edit.json) feeds them, and the empty latent at width × height instead of the first picture's size. Made for the Rust rebuild (docs/comfy/goals/rust-rebuild.md R2) so Generate Image with references stops needing 2511 on ComfyUI; the native worker (genai-native gn-diffusion qwen-2.1/image-ref) is its main route. The ComfyUI graph uses only nodes and inputs the shipped 2.1 templates use; this combination of them was not run live.
